verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions AI-generated insights or suggestions. The 'insights' references (docs-32, docs-36) describe conventional customizable reports, which is an adjacent feature and not AI-driven analysis. An AI insights feature is a fair axis for an invoicing SaaS, so the absence of evidence yields 'none' rather than 'na'.
